title: Trim core's JSON utilities to what core uses
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO direction 2026-11-18: core under 25,000 lines; split core's JSON utilities. susi-config's json_util keeps what core uses (JsonFields, DynamicValue, DynamicRegistry, atomic_write_bytes, atomic_replace_unsynced, read_atomic_bytes, merge_missing_json_defaults and their staging helpers). Once Susi Commercial Apps owns the rest with their tests (T-CLAUDEJSON-1), delete core's copies and tests and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING.

reuse.searched: Core's susi-config json_util and its callers in susi-core and the config crate; Susi Commercial Apps' config runtime. Delete-only: no new code and no dependency.
